minecraft:written_book_content.title: 001: Torterra Variants
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Professor Sans
pages: "I was intrigued when I first heard the rumors: a Grottle’s evolution altered by the sapling it holds. Not unheard of—there are tales of Pokémon changing form based on items or environment—but this? This was different."

{"text":"I gave a Grottle a Mangrove Sapling from the swamps and left it in natural sunlight. By Day 3, it had transformed into a Mangrove Torterra—towering, serene, and somehow... in tune with the wetlands.
"}

{"text":"I've begun cataloging these variant Tortera forms, each deeply bonded to the biome their sapling represents.  So far, I’ve observed signs of change when the pokemon is exposed to:
- Spruce
- Dark Oak
- Birch
- Oak
"}

{"text":"I theorize the sapling acts as a genetic key, imprinting environmental data into Grottle’s evolution. Less about battle typing—more about ecological resonance.
"}

{"text":"If this proves true, it could reshape how we understand evolution entirely.
"}
